thread:
mira (Revenue): Noticed an unexpected drop in our March deferred schedule during pre-close reconciliation. Vendor invoice INV-82134 from CloudStack has a $35,640 line that the billing pipeline treated as an instant discount instead of a prepaid hosting credit. Could be related to the A/B pricing experiment toggles. tagging oscar and linh.

close-bot: New vendor invoice posted: INV-82134 (CloudStack). Amount: $35,640. Received 2026-03-29 19:20 UTC.

oscar (Billing): I pulled the event. The experiment service set promo_flag=true for certain SKUs; our mapping converts promo_flag->contra_revenue. For CloudStack vendor prepayments we should map to prepaid_hosted. So the system reduced recognized revenue by $2,730 this run.

linh (Controller): Is that $2,730 already in the GL? If so we need a reversing JE + establishing deferred. Provide the vendor PDF, mapping snapshot, and suggested JE.

mira (Revenue): It's in draft GL as contra. Proposed entries:

```
Reversing JE (March 2026)
Dr Contra-Revenue 2,730
Cr Accounts Payable 2,730
Memo: Reverse auto-applied contra for INV-82134 mis-map (CloudStack)

Establish deferral (full invoice)
Dr Accounts Payable 35,640
Cr Deferred Revenue 35,640
Memo: Record prepaid hosting (CloudStack INV-82134) amort 12 months
```

eoscar (Billing): I'll attach the invoice and the billing event export to WP-INV-82134 and open a mapping PR to change promo_flag->prepaid_hosted for vendor=CloudStack SKUs matching "hosted-commit". PR link will go into the workpaper.

eva (FP&A): Quick P&L check: if amort over 12 months monthly expense reduction ~ $2,970. Current over/under recognition this month = +$2,730 recognized too much; after correction we'll move $35,640 to deferral and reduce current revenue.

linh (Controller): Upload docs needed for audit: invoice PDF, billing export, mapping snapshot, and contract confirming term. Once attached I can approve the JE.

mira (Revenue): Uploaded: https://files.redwood/INV-82134.pdf, billing export: https://files.redwood/billing/export-82134.csv, mapping snapshot: https://docs.redwood/pricing/mapping-2026-03-27, contract CR-4620 (12-month). Added a short root-cause note: experiment toggle leaked promo_tag into vendor invoice generator.

oscar (Billing): PR opened: https://git.redwood/billing/pulls/210. Workpaper created: WP-INV-82134-cloudstack-fix.

linh (Controller): Reviewed attachments. Approve reversing JE + deferral establishment. Please route the workpaper and JE to accounting@redwood.com and cc me. I'll post before EOD close.

eva (FP&A): I'll update the month close pack and deferred schedule once JE posts. Also adding this to the quarterly controls review: ensure experiment toggles cascade to billing mapping rules.

mira (Revenue): Thanks all. Oscar, run a 90-day query for CloudStack invoices with promo_flag and drop results here so we can batch-review.

oscar (Billing): Will run the query in the morning and post results to WP. For now only INV-82134 flagged in the draft run.

mira (Revenue): Closing loop 44d - will follow up after PR merges.
